**Visual observations from test image:**
- Multiple soybean plants at/near soil line level
- Very dark (black/dark brown) necrotic tissue at stem bases
- Orange-brown discoloration on some stem tissue
- Plants appear dead/collapsed at the base
- Dry, wilted appearance of upper plant material

**Key diagnostic features:**
- The dark, almost black rotting at the stem base near the soil line is the prominent feature
- The lower stem collapse with dark discoloration extending upward matches Phytophthora's "dark chocolate-brown stem discoloration from below soil line upward"
- The dead plants with leaves/pods still attached also matches Phytophthora

The Phytophthora reference collage (top-left panel) closely matches — showing similarly dead plants with dark stem bases in a field setting.
